post.originalText:
Opus 5.5 making a product video from one prompt is wild.

The easy version: open your coding editor in the same project as the product. The model already knows the codebase. You don't brief the brand, the flows, or the screens.

You just point at a reference and say: make a product demo show reel.

I did that for The Talent App. This video is the result — watch it and you'll see what TTA actually is, without a 20-slide deck.

If hiring ops still feel like a cabinet of resumes, adopt The Talent App for your organization. One demo reel makes the product clearer than another feature list ever will.
